entities.summary: Nargiz Aliyarova is a professor of the Baku Music Academy, soloist of the Azerbaijan State Piano Trio, laureate of the 2nd Republican Competition of Musicians, founder of the National Society of Music and Global Culture, laureate of international competitions, Honored Artist of Azerbaijan.
